head: 9d2474373ab7e0cef35d763c9e014397c993de92
scope: Complete remaining local code-operator parity by making bounded code_read, code_imports, and bounded JSONL code_watch live in the canonical codeserve protocol, with compatibility-preserving catalog/contract updates, safe path and resource bounds, tests, and documentation.
non_goals: Do not add hosted sync, tenancy, remote overlays, or session continuation memory.
Do not change legacy response shapes for existing verbs.
Do not replace the existing codecrawl watcher implementation.
Do not add external model/provider dependencies.
risks: Public JSONL catalog and verb behavior changes can break consumers if aliases or response envelopes drift.
Source reads and watcher requests must remain bounded and symlink-safe.
A watch request must not hang indefinitely when called through JSONL or tests.
